name: Windows 95-themed interactive guide to agentic AI coding

mentions.name: Windows 95-themed interactive guide to agentic AI coding
mentions.description: This is a Windows 95-themed interactive guide on agentic AI coding, organized into seven chapters with a codebase readiness scorer, an ROI calculator, and copyable artifacts for engineering leads. It includes a hidden SkiFree game, an original chiptune soundtrack, achievement badges, and a Red Pill / Blue Pill choice that can BSOD the browser. It was built entirely with Claude Code, teaching the same workflow it was made with.
mentions.audience: Engineering leads, for whom the guide provides a codebase readiness scorer, ROI calculator, and copyable artifacts
